data.title: 阿蕾克希亚 · 冬日屋檐下的围巾与热饮
data.description: 飘雪的冬日商业街屋檐下，阿蕾克希亚红着脸将一条厚实的红色针织围巾拉开，悄悄分给身边的少年一半。双手捧着热可可纸杯，眼眸倒映着漫天落雪与温柔心意。
data.location: snow-covered street corner under wooden awning, soft snowfall in background
data.action: standing close under shop eaves, sharing a long red knit scarf around partner's neck, holding steaming paper cup with both hands, blushing tsundere expression, gentle sidelong gaze
data.lighting: soft diffuse winter daylight with warm lantern glow from shop window
data.mood: sweet winter date romance, guarded tsundere vulnerability, cozy warmth in cold
data.promptProse: Under a snow-dusted shop awning, silver-haired princess Alexia in a casual hoodie shares her warm red scarf, cradling a steaming hot cocoa cup with a flustered, endearing blush.
data.animaCaption: Sharing her warm knit scarf beneath the snowy eaves, she cradles a hot drink with a bashful blush.
